description: P26 follow-up: an API-shaped NOMAIN module (int(10) return, output DS) compiled with PGMINFO(*PCML *STMF) succeeds and yields PCML without Error comments; also CRTSRVPGM + DSPSRVPGM. The first batch (part09-03-pcml) showed non-int return types make PGMINFO fail with RNF0319 severity 20. Only &LIB objects; cleaned at the end.

steps.label: MKCUR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYCUR (TAG VARCHAR(40), ORD INT, LIB VARCHAR(20), TYPE VARCHAR(10))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: REC0
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFYCUR SELECT ''A0-AFTER-CHGCURLIB'', ORDINAL_POSITION, SCHEMA_NAME, TYPE FROM QSYS2.LIBRARY_LIST_INFO') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MODA
steps.cmd: CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/ZAIAPI) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(ZAIAPI) PGMINFO(*PCML *STMF) INFOSTMF('/tmp/vfy0903b/zaiapi.pcml') REPLACE(*YES) TGTCCSID(*JOB)

steps.label: CALLIT
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'ZAIAPI'" 2>&1

steps.label: CLEAN
steps.cmd: system "DLTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/ZAIAPI)" 2>&1; system "DLTMOD MODULE(&LIB/ZAIAPI)" 2>&1; system "RMVM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(ZAIAPI)" 2>&1; rm -f /tmp/vfy0903b/*.pcml; rmdir /tmp/vfy0903b 2>&1; echo cleaned

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ORD, LIB, TYPE FROM &LIB/VFYCUR WHERE TAG = 'A0-AFTER-CHGCURLIB' ORDER BY ORD
